item.description:
Downloads now prepare one MP4 automatically, prefer Turkish audio when available, and play locally inside IPTVMac.
- Normal Quit saves resumable transfer state. Each Mac keeps its own downloads; provider support is required for HTTP resume. - Downloaded bytes and conversion checkpoints survive interruption. Failed preparation retries locally instead of downloading again. - Turkish audio becomes the first/default track when present. Alternate audio remains in the same MP4; portable audio conversion is automatic. - Validated MP4 output is committed before app-owned MKV/intermediate files are permanently removed. Failed preparation preserves the input. - Movie and episode files use Movies/IPTVMovie and Movies/IPTVSeries in separate account folders. Existing tracked downloads migrate locally. - Completed rows play in the app. Finder, Pause/Resume, Retry and confirmed Delete are available through the ellipsis/right-click menu. - A previously online-verified owner can open their Downloads when Firebase is unreachable. First open this version online once to create that device-local access. - Missing files are checked again before play; stale file metadata no longer admits removed files.
Validation: 425 relevant tests passed with one optional Vision test skipped; real synthetic multi-audio FFmpeg/ffprobe tests passed. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Development-signed and unnotarized, as requested. This package contains no personal playlist or provider subscription.
